description: For PowerShell modules that depend on The Code Kitchen modules (PowerCraft.*, CodeCompass.*). Reads the versions in RequiredModules of a .psd1 manifest and opens a pull request when the PowerShell Gallery has a newer one.

customManagers.description: RequiredModules entries that name a version, looked up on the PowerShell Gallery. The version is read as a plain version, not as a NuGet range: NuGet reads 1.2.0 as 1.2.0 or later, which every newer release satisfies, so nothing would ever be proposed.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor releases of The Code Kitchen modules: one pull request, merged when the checks pass
Major releases of The Code Kitchen modules: labelled, and left for a person
